name: Samantha Lee
source:
A goal-oriented and determined student, Sami happily helps Mimi adjust to her new school environment.

She becomes a source for many of Mimi's comic ideas, often taking on the role of the protagonist.

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1997.
Orientation: Heterosexual.
Hometown: Chapel Hill, North Carolina.
